notes: digestVectors: body is the attestation body (v1). expected.ok = digest and the exact preimage bytes (UTF8 domain, 0x00, canonical map as in action-digest.mjs); otherwise expected.code (malformed | ttl) and field.
classificationVectors: adapters is the list of adapter facts the Broker read ([{connected, switchType}]); adaptersOmitted = the value was missing. expected is none | present | unknown.
The C# twin is NetworkAttestation.cs (digest vectors and verifyVectors; classification is Broker-side and has no twin). It reproduces every expected value here in the dotnet contract test.
The C# twin is NetworkAttestation.cs (digest vectors and verifyVectors; classification is Broker-side and has no twin). It reproduces every expected value here in the dotnet contract test.

verifyVectors: the public half of an EPHEMERAL ECDSA P-256 test key (publicKeySpki, base64 DER; the private key was discarded after signing, nothing secret is in this file) and signed envelopes made with it. For each case, verifyNetworkAttestation(signed, { clock: now, verify: the pinned key under keyId, expected }) must give result: ok, or the code and field of the refusal. expected.vmId null means the caller has no VM id to compare. The signature is ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256 over the canonical bytes, IEEE P1363 (64 bytes), unpadded base64url. Both the Node and C# implementations must reproduce every result.
